name: Codex Twilight
description: Twilight Forest content for Arclight: dimension/biome/structure backports plus paired Fabric client renderers, block-entity renderers, particles, sounds, and assets. The server and client both load this jar so Twilight registry ids sync directly without server-side paired-client disguises.

_codex_phase_note: Phase 1 currently lands GrassColor 1:1 visually via codec-side decode swap (TFGrassColorModifierCodec) instead of MM enum extension, because the runtime `BiomeSpecialEffects$GrassColorModifier` constructor takes (String, ColorModifier) and the ColorModifier inner interface cannot be Class.forName'd during MM preApply transformation. The CodexGrassColorEarlyRiser entrypoint stays declared so Phase 2 can iterate on it once the timing/Proxy approach is fixed; for now the entrypoint runs and silently no-ops the addEnum calls if the class lookup fails.
